title: ABRAHAM
who: Abraham was called by God to leave his homeland and travel toward Canaan.
moment: He trusted God's promise and set out, even before he knew every step of the route.
fact: Abraham's family travelled from Ur to Haran before he continued toward Canaan.
question: What helps you obey God when the whole route is not yet clear?

title: JOSEPH
who: Joseph was Jacob's son who rose from prisoner to governor in Egypt.
moment: Joseph prepared grain during years of plenty and later helped many people survive famine.
fact: Joseph's family settled in Goshen, a fertile region in Egypt.
question: How can you use wisdom today to prepare well and help others?

title: MOSES
who: God chose Moses to lead Israel out of Egypt and receive His covenant.
moment: At Mount Sinai, Moses met with God and brought His commands to the people.
connected: Egypt · Red Sea · Mount Sinai · Kadesh
fact: Israel camped in front of Mount Sinai after leaving Egypt.
question: Which command helps you love God or other people more faithfully today?

title: THE EXODUS
who: The Exodus was God's rescue of the Israelites from slavery in Egypt.
moment: God made a dry path through the sea, and the people crossed safely.
fact: The Exodus became one of Israel's great stories of rescue and freedom.
question: When have you needed courage to take the next safe step?

title: JERICHO
who: Jericho was a fortified city near the Jordan and Israel's first major city in Canaan.
moment: The people followed God's unusual instructions, and the city's walls fell.
fact: Jericho stood near an important route leading into the hill country.
question: What does faithful obedience look like when you do not understand the whole plan?

title: DAVID
who: David was a shepherd, psalmist and king who made Jerusalem Israel's capital.
moment: David established his rule in Jerusalem and called it the City of David.
fact: David first ruled Judah from Hebron before reigning from Jerusalem.
question: How can you use influence to serve rather than simply feel important?

title: DANIEL
who: Daniel was a Judean exile who served in Babylon and remained faithful to God.
moment: Daniel kept praying even when a royal order made it dangerous.
fact: Daniel served under more than one empire while keeping his faith.
question: What habit can help you remain faithful when pressure rises?

title: BETHLEHEM
who: Bethlehem was a small Judean town linked to David and the birth of Jesus.
moment: Jesus was born there, and shepherds came after the angelic announcement.
fact: Bethlehem is called the City of David in Luke's account of Jesus' birth.
question: Why do you think God often works through places that seem small?

title:
JESUS CALMS
THE STORM
who: Jesus and His disciples crossed the Sea of Galilee in a fishing boat.
moment: Jesus commanded the wind and waves, and a great calm followed.
fact: The disciples asked one another who Jesus was after the wind and sea obeyed Him.
question: What fear can you bring to Jesus instead of facing it alone?

title:
PAUL'S JOURNEY
TO ROME
who: Paul travelled as a prisoner and witness from Caesarea toward Rome.
moment: Through storms, shipwreck and delay, Paul encouraged others and kept going.
fact: Paul reached Rome after spending three months on Malta.
question: How can you encourage others when a plan changes or takes longer?
